content: Mana ali tarabaccunamanda

Chihuasha Jesus shuc yachachina shimita cuintangahua callarira casna nisha, Shuc runaga uvas nishca chagrata rasha quinzhara. Chasnallata chi uvas muyugunata chahuasha upinata rangahua shuc juctuta allara. Chasnallata shuc huasita jahuata shayachira shuhuangahua shamuc runagunata ricungahua. Ñáa tucuita alichishcahuasha shuc mañachishca runagunama paihua chagrata saquira pallana uras chaupi chaupita ñucama cachahuanauchun nisha. Chihuasha pasiangahua caruma rira.
Pallana uras pactaricpi chagra amu chi mañachishca runagunahuagma shuc cuirac runata cachara ñucahuacta apapagri nisha.
Paiguna randi chi cuirac runata apangahua shamucta japisha libachisha imas illacta cachanaura.
Chihuasha shuc cuiractahuas cachara. Paitaga umai huactasha nanachisha piñasha jiridsagunata rimanaura.
Shuctahuas cachara. Chitaga huanchinaurami. Chihuashas mas ashca runagunata cachara. Chigunatahuas chasnallata libachinaura, shuccunata huactanaura, shuccunata huanchinaura.
Chara shuc runa puchura, chiga paihua churi mara. Paitahuas cachara, paitaga mana imatas ranaungachu nisha ñuca llaquishca churi ashcamanda paitaga uyanaungami nisha.

Astahuanbas chi churi pactacpi chi runaguna paigunapura cuintanacunaura, Caimi amuhua churi nisha, paimi amuyangaraun. Paita huanchishun chi pai japingaraushcagunata ñucanchillata amuyangahua nisha cuintanacunaura.
Chasna cuintasha paita japisha huanchisha paihua aichata pagllama shitanaura. Jesus chasna cuintasha yachachira. Cunan rimahuaichi nira,
Imasnata ranga chi amuga. Pai shamusha chi tarabaccunataga huinda huanchinga. Paihua chagrata shuccunama randi cunga.
Manachu Diospa Shimita ricushcanguichi. Casnami nin:

content.text: Chita ricusha ñucanchi cushi maunchi nin.

content: Chi israel amuguna Jesus rimashcata uyasha ñucanchita uyachishami chasna riman nisha yuyarinaura. Chasna yuyarisha piñasha paita japinata munanaura huanchishun nisha, randi runagunata manzhasha huanchinata mana ushanaurachu. Chasna asha Jesusta saquisha rinaura.
Gubirnuma cullquita paganamanda

Chihuasha chi amugunaga shuc fariseogunatas, mandac amu Herodesta caticcunandi Jesuspagma cachanaura paita ima shimigunatas tapusha pandachingahua nisha. Pai pandacpi caudsayachishun nisha cachanaura.

Paiguna Jesuspagma pactamusha rimanaura, Señor can mana llullashachu sirtuta rimasha yachachic aucta yachanchi. Mana pitas manzhasha pariulla chi tupullata ricungui. Runaguna Dios munashcashina causachun nisha sirtuta yachachingui. Chasna asha cunan rimahuai, ñucanchita mandauc romano gubirnu mandashca cullquitaga paima paganaga balinzhu, manachu balin. Paganachu, manachu pagana. Imata ningui can nisha tapunaura.
Jesusca paiguna paita pandachingahua nisha raushcata yachasha nira, Imangahuata ñucata camashun nisha shamunguichi. Shuc cullquita ricuchihuaichi nira.
Ricuchicpi paigunata tapura, Pihuactan cai cullquibi auc ñahui. Pihua shutitan caibi tiyauc. Tapucpi rimanaura, Romano amuhuac man.
Chasna rimacpi Jesus nira, Amuhuacta amuma cuichi, Diospactaga Diosma cuichi nira. Pai rimashcata manzharishami uyanaura.
Causarinamanda Jesusta tapushcamanda

Israel muntunmanda maican saduceo nishca runagunaga Jesusta tapungahua shamunaura. Paiguna nic anaura huañushcahuasha cuti causarinaga mana tiyanzhu nisha. Chasna acpi shuc saduceoguna Jesusta tapunaura,

Señor, huañuc Moises quillcasha mandaitucushcanchi casna: punda huauqui shuc huahua illac huañucpiga paimanda quipa huauqui randi chi huaccha huarmita japina man paihua huañushca huauquihua allpa ama chingarichun nisha paihua shutita churanauchun nira.
Cunanga imata ranatan. Canzhis (7) huauquipura anaura. Punda huauquiga shuc huarmita japisha randi mana churita tupashallata huañura.
Paihua quipa huauqui chi huarmita japira, randi chasnallata churi illac huañura.
Tucui chi canzhis huauquiguna chi huarmillata japisha huañunaura. Ni shucpas mana huahuata tupanaurachu, churi illac huañunaura huinguna. Puchucaibi huarmihuas huañura.
Ñáa causarina punzhai chi huarmiga pihuactanga chi tucui canzhis paita japishca acpi ninaura.
Chasna cuintashcata uyasha Jesus paigunata rimara, Diospa shimita mana yachashcamanda pandaunguichi, Diospa ushaitas mana ricsinguichichu.
Huañushcaguna cuti causarishcahuasha carigunas huarmigunas mana japinacunaungachu, jahuapachaibi tiyac angelgunacuinta tucungaunami huarmi illac.
Chi huañusha causarinamandaga huañuc Moises quillcashcata manachu ricushcanguichi. Chi sindiu ruyamanda Moisesta Dios rimara casna nisha, Ñáuca Abrahanba Isaacpa Jacobopa Dios mani.

Pai chasna rimasha paiga mana huañushca runagunahua Dioschan. Astahuanbas chi quimsa (3) rucuguna huañushca ashahuas chara causanaunmi. Moises rimashcamanda yachanchi Yaya Diosca causaucunahua Dios man. Cangunaga chimanda pandaunguichimi nira.
Mas balic mandashca shimimanda
Moises mandashca shimigunata yachachic runaga chi saduceogunata uyasha Jesus ali cutipashcata ricsisha Jesusta tapura, Tucui mandashca shimigunamanda maicanda mas yali ali balic an nisha.
Tapucpi Jesus nira, Mas balic mandashcaga caimi:

content.text: Uyaichi israel runaguna, ñucanchi jatun Dios shuglla Diosmi.
Camba Diosta tucui camba shunguhuan, tucui camba almahuan, tucui camba yuyaihuan, tucui camba ushaihuanbas llaquina mangui.

content: Caiga yali balic shimi man.
Chimandahuashaga shuca casna nin:

content.text: Camba quiquin aichata llaquishcacuintallata shuccunatahuas llaquina mangui.

content: Chi ishcai (2) mandashcagunamanda shuc yalicta mandanaga mana tiyanzhu.
Chi runa Jesus rimashcata uyasha nira, Alimi señor, sirtuta rimangui shuc Dios tiyan, paimanda shuca mas mana tiyanzhu.

Paita tucui shunguhuan, tucui yuyaihuan, tucui munaihuan, tucui ushaihuan llaquina mangui, shuccunata quiquin amu aichatacuinta llaquinami. Casna aichata rupachisha Diosma ricuchina randimanda, chasnallata Diosma imatas cuna randimanda, cai ishcai mandashca shimigunata pactachinaga yapa mas yali balin nira.
Chi Moises mandashcata yachac runa ali yuyaihuan rimacpi Jesus paita rimara, Diospa ali mandanamanda mana caruichaungui. Chihuasha tucuiguna manzharisha mana pihuas Jesusta mas tapunata munanaurachu.
Cristoga pihua churitan nisha tapushcamanda
Jesus Diosta alabana huasibi yachachisha chibi auc runagunata tapura, Moises mandashca shimita yachachiccuna Cristoga rey amu Davidba churi ashcata imasna nishata ninaun.
Davidllata Diospa Samai paita casna yuyachicpi nira:

content.text: Jatun amu Diosca ñucata mandactami casna nisha rimara:

content: Huañuc Davidllata Cristota amu nisha rimacpiga imasnata Cristoga Davidba miraimanda churi angaya, nisha Jesus paigunata tapura. Jesus chasna yachachicpi runagunaga cushihuan paita uyaunaura.
Israel amugunamanda Jesus riman

Huasha Jesus yachachiusha rimara, Moises mandashca shimigunata yachachic runagunamanda cuiraringuichi. Paiguna mas balic tucusha nisha suni llachapata churarinaun. Pulasaibi saludaitucunatas munanaun.
Balichishca tucunatas munasha israel tandarina huasigunaibis punda tiyarinata mascanaun. Chasnallata jista micunaibi punda mesaibi tiyarinata munanauna.
Chasna agllaita huaccha huarmiguna allpatas huasitas quichunaun. Diosta yapa unaita mañanaun runaguna balichihuanauchun nisha. Chimandami paiguna mas ashcata taripashca tucunaunga nisha yachachira.
Huaccha huarmi pai charishcata Diosma cushcamanda

Shuc punzha Jesus Diosta alabana huasibi tiyaura Diosma cumbirana cullquita tandachina cajun mayanbi runaguna shitashcata ricusha. Chibi tiyasha yapa charic runaguna chi cajunbi ashca cullquita churaushcata ricuura.
Chasnallata shuc pugri huaccha huarmi shamusha mana ashcata charic ashallata mana balichishca cullqui ishcaillata (2) churara.
Chita ricusha Jesus pai japishcagunata caillayaichi nisha paigunata rimara, Cangunata sirtuta nini, tucui cullquita churaccunamanda cai huaccha huarmi tucuimanda yalictami churara.
Chi cullquiyuccuna tucui munashcata randishcahuasha puchushca cullquitaga churac shamunaura nira. Randi cai huaccha huarmiga pai micuna randina cullquita tucui pai charishcatami illacta churara nira.
